name: How long does a typical minor home repair take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical minor home repair take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standalone minor repairs, such as repairing a drywall hole or replacing loose molding, take between two to four hours. However, projects that involve compound drying, painting, or tile grout curing may require two visits or a full business day. For instance, applying joint compound and texture over a water-damaged ceiling section needs adequate drying time before our crew can apply a matching primer and finish paint. We review cure times during the initial assessment so you know the exact schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most minor repairs take between 2 and 4 hours, though repairs requiring multi-layer drywall mud or tile grout may need extra curing time or a second brief visit.
